Howon · Listen & Shadow 02

Class 3–4 Review — dance, money, who I've become, neighbours, people
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · DANCE AND EUROPE
👤 Brian
Tell me about the dance scene in Europe.
유럽 댄스 씬 얘기를 해볼까요.
scene — 업계, 판
💬 Howon
The freestyle hip-hop field in Europe doesn't really accept Korean dancers.
유럽 프리스타일 힙합 판은 한국 댄서를 잘 받아주지 않아요.
field — 분야, 판 · accept — 받아들이다
같은 패턴으로 — That industry doesn't really accept outsiders. · The market there doesn't accept new names easily.
💬 Howon
We're good at b-boying, but not at freestyle hip-hop.
우리는 비보잉은 잘하는데 프리스타일 힙합은 아니에요.
be good at ~ — ~를 잘하다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm good at choreography, but not at freestyle. · He's good at acting, but not at singing.
💬 Howon
I want to make a breakthrough there — in a bigger field.
거기서 돌파구를 만들고 싶어요 — 더 큰 판으로요.
breakthrough — 돌파구 · bigger field — 더 큰 무대
같은 패턴으로 — I want to make a breakthrough in the US market. · She made her breakthrough at thirty.
💬 Howon
The trap is falling into the typical cliché.
전형적인 클리셰에 빠지는 게 함정이에요.
trap — 함정 · cliché — 뻔한 것, 상투적인 것
같은 패턴으로 — The trap is trying to please everyone. · The trap is thinking you already know.
💬 Howon
Imitating and improvising are completely different things.
따라 하는 것과 즉흥으로 하는 건 완전히 달라요.
imitate — 따라 하다 · improvise — 즉흥으로 하다
같은 패턴으로 — Watching and doing are completely different things. · Knowing and teaching are two different things.
💬 Howon
I'm still figuring it out.
아직 정리가 다 안 됐어요.
figure out — 알아내다, 정리하다
같은 패턴으로 — I'm still figuring out the next step. · We're still figuring out the schedule.
PART 2 · MONEY AND FAMILY
👤 Brian
How do you think about money?
돈 얘기는 어떻게 생각해요?
think about ~ — ~에 대해 생각하다
💬 Howon
I've been the man of the house since I was young.
어릴 때부터 집안을 책임졌어요.
man of the house — 집안을 책임지는 사람 (소년가장)
같은 패턴으로 — He's been the man of the house since his father passed. · She's been the one holding the family together.
💬 Howon
I paid my own university tuition.
대학 등록금을 제가 냈어요.
tuition — 등록금
같은 패턴으로 — I paid my own rent from twenty. · He paid his own way through school.
💬 Howon
I've paid off my debt.
빚은 다 갚았어요.
pay off — 갚다 · debt — 빚
같은 패턴으로 — I paid off the loan last year. · We've paid off most of it.
💬 Howon
Inheritance tax and gift tax are two different things.
상속세랑 증여세는 완전히 다른 얘기예요.
inheritance tax — 상속세 · gift tax — 증여세
같은 패턴으로 — Rent and maintenance are two different things. · Talent and discipline are two different things.
💬 Howon
I've made up my mind.
마음을 정했어요.
make up one's mind — 마음을 정하다
같은 패턴으로 — I made up my mind last night. · Once I make up my mind, I don't look back.
PART 3 · WHO I'VE BECOME
👤 Brian
What were you like in your twenties?
20대 때는 어땠어요?
What were you like? — 어떤 사람이었어요?
💬 Howon
I became more negative in my early twenties — a lot of people in the industry influenced me.
20대 초반에 더 부정적으로 변했어요 — 업계 사람들 영향을 많이 받았어요.
negative — 부정적인 · influence — 영향을 주다
같은 패턴으로 — I became more careful after that job. · That trip influenced me more than I expected.
💬 Howon
I don't want to fall into a victim mindset.
피해자 사고방식에 빠지고 싶지 않아요.
victim mindset — 피해자 사고방식 · fall into ~ — ~에 빠지다
같은 패턴으로 — I don't want to fall into that habit. · He fell into a negative mindset.
💬 Howon
Admitting something and accepting it aren't the same.
인정하는 것과 받아들이는 건 다르죠.
admit — 인정하다 · accept — 받아들이다
같은 패턴으로 — Hearing and listening aren't the same. · Apologising and changing aren't the same.
💬 Howon
I try to stay present.
지금 이 순간에 있으려고 해요.
stay present — 현재에 머물다
같은 패턴으로 — I try to stay calm. · I try to stay out of that.
💬 Howon
There's a silver lining to it.
나쁜 일에도 좋은 면은 있어요.
silver lining — 나쁜 일 속의 좋은 면
같은 패턴으로 — There's a silver lining — I learned a lot. · Every mess has a silver lining.
💬 Howon
It is what it is.
그냥 그런 거죠, 어쩔 수 없어요.
It is what it is. — 어쩔 수 없다, 그런 거다
같은 패턴으로 — It is what it is — I moved on. · At this point, it is what it is.
PART 4 · THE NEIGHBOURS
👤 Brian
Tell me about the noise problem.
층간소음 얘기 좀 해주세요.
noise problem — 소음 문제
💬 Howon
I have a noise problem with the people upstairs.
윗집이랑 층간소음 문제가 있어요.
noise between floors — 층간소음 · upstairs — 윗집
같은 패턴으로 — I have a parking problem with my neighbour. · We had an issue with the people next door.
💬 Howon
I hear footsteps all night.
밤새 발소리가 들려요.
footsteps — 발소리
같은 패턴으로 — I hear the door all night. · You can hear everything through that wall.
💬 Howon
I wanted to grab him by the collar.
그 사람 멱살을 잡고 싶었어요.
grab someone by the collar — 멱살을 잡다
같은 패턴으로 — I wanted to grab him by the arm. · He grabbed me by the sleeve.
💬 Howon
I didn't want it to turn violent.
폭력적으로 가고 싶진 않았어요.
turn violent — 폭력적으로 되다
같은 패턴으로 — I didn't want it to turn into a fight. · It turned ugly fast.
💬 Howon
It left an emotional scar.
그 일은 마음에 상처로 남았어요.
emotional scar — 마음의 상처
같은 패턴으로 — That year left a scar. · It left a mark on both of us.
PART 5 · THE PEOPLE I KEEP
👤 Brian
How do you choose the people around you?
사람은 어떻게 고르세요?
choose — 고르다
💬 Howon
I like someone who takes care of themselves.
자기 자신을 잘 챙기는 사람이 좋아요.
take care of oneself — 자기를 챙기다
같은 패턴으로 — I like someone who knows what they want. · I like people who show up on time.
💬 Howon
I don't like superficial relationships.
겉만 번지르르한 관계는 별로예요.
superficial — 피상적인, 겉만의
같은 패턴으로 — I don't like superficial compliments. · That conversation felt superficial.
💬 Howon
We've got some distance now.
저희는 좀 멀어졌어요.
get distance — 거리가 생기다
같은 패턴으로 — We've got some distance since then. · There's distance between us now.
💬 Howon
We rarely keep in touch these days.
이제는 거의 연락 안 해요.
rarely — 거의 ~ 않다 · keep in touch — 연락하며 지내다
같은 패턴으로 — We rarely see each other. · I rarely check that app.
💬 Howon
I've got softer over the years.
저는 예전보다 부드러워졌어요.
get softer — 부드러워지다
같은 패턴으로 — I've got calmer over the years. · He's got quieter since then.
💬 Howon
That question threw me off a bit.
그 질문은 좀 당황스러웠어요.
throw someone off — 당황하게 하다
같은 패턴으로 — His answer threw me off. · The timing threw me off.
